#!/bin/bash
set -e

LOG="/root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/auto_eval_pipeline.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1

echo "=== AUTO EVAL PIPELINE STARTED at $(date -u) ==="

# ====== Phase 1: Wait for training to complete ======
echo "[Phase 1] Monitoring exp-004-heldout training..."

while true; do
    TRAIN_PID=$(ps aux | grep "run_exp004_heldout" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | head -1)
    
    if [ -z "$TRAIN_PID" ]; then
        echo "[$(date -u)] Training process not found - checking completion..."
        
        if [ -d "/root/autodl-tmp/contrastive_entrain_calib/outputs/exp004_heldout/checkpoint-8000" ]; then
            echo "[$(date -u)] TRAINING COMPLETE - checkpoint-8000 found"
            break
        fi
        
        # Check latest checkpoint
        LATEST_CKPT=$(ls -d /root/autodl-tmp/contrastive_entrain_calib/outputs/exp004_heldout/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | sort -t- -k2 -n | tail -1)
        echo "[$(date -u)] WARNING: process gone but checkpoint-8000 not found. Latest: $LATEST_CKPT"
        echo "[$(date -u)] Waiting 5 minutes to confirm..."
        sleep 300
        
        TRAIN_PID2=$(ps aux | grep "run_exp004_heldout" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | head -1)
        if [ -z "$TRAIN_PID2" ]; then
            echo "[$(date -u)] Process confirmed gone. Proceeding with eval."
            break
        fi
        echo "[$(date -u)] Process reappeared, continuing monitoring."
    fi
    
    # Report progress
    STEP=$(tail -5 /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/exp-004-heldout.log 2>/dev/null | grep -oP 'step=\K[0-9]+' | tail -1)
    echo "[$(date -u)] Training at step ${STEP:-unknown}/8000, PID=$TRAIN_PID"
    
    sleep 600
done

echo "[Phase 1] COMPLETE at $(date -u)"
echo "PHASE1_DONE" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

# ====== Phase 2: Install lm-eval and run evals ======
echo "[Phase 2] Setting up lm-eval..."
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export TRANSFORMERS_CACHE=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=0
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1

# Install lm-eval if not installed
if ! pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -q lm-eval; then
    echo "[$(date -u)] Installing lm-eval..."
    source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true
    pip install lm-eval --timeout 300
fi

echo "[$(date -u)] lm-eval version: $(pip show lm-eval 2>/dev/null | grep Version)"

mkdir -p /root/eval_results/lm_eval/{vanilla,act_best,r3only_best}

echo "PHASE2_EVAL_START" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

# --- Eval 1: Vanilla Qwen3-8B ---
echo "=== [$(date -u)] Starting Vanilla Qwen3-8B eval ==="
echo "EVAL_VANILLA_RUNNING" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 lm_eval --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks mmlu,gsm8k \
    --batch_size auto \
    --num_fewshot 5 \
    --output_path /root/eval_results/lm_eval/vanilla \
    2>&1

echo "[$(date -u)] Vanilla eval DONE"
echo "EVAL_VANILLA_DONE" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

# --- Eval 2: ACT s1 ckpt-8000 ---
echo "=== [$(date -u)] Starting ACT s1 ckpt-8000 eval ==="
echo "EVAL_ACT_RUNNING" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 lm_eval --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B,peft=/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/backups/act-s1/checkpoint-8000,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks mmlu,gsm8k \
    --batch_size auto \
    --num_fewshot 5 \
    --output_path /root/eval_results/lm_eval/act_best \
    2>&1

echo "[$(date -u)] ACT eval DONE"
echo "EVAL_ACT_DONE" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

# --- Eval 3: R3-only s1 ckpt-6500 ---
echo "=== [$(date -u)] Starting R3-only s1 ckpt-6500 eval ==="
echo "EVAL_R3ONLY_RUNNING" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 lm_eval --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B,peft=/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp003_r3only_seed1/checkpoint-6500,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks mmlu,gsm8k \
    --batch_size auto \
    --num_fewshot 5 \
    --output_path /root/eval_results/lm_eval/r3only_best \
    2>&1

echo "[$(date -u)] R3-only eval DONE"
echo "EVAL_R3ONLY_DONE" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt

# ====== Phase 3: Collect results ======
echo ""
echo "========================================="
echo "=== ALL EVALS COMPLETE at $(date -u) ==="
echo "========================================="
echo ""

echo "=== RESULTS SUMMARY ==="
for model in vanilla act_best r3only_best; do
    echo "--- $model ---"
    RESULTS_FILE=$(find /root/eval_results/lm_eval/$model -name "results.json" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$RESULTS_FILE" ]; then
        python3 -c "
import json
with open('$RESULTS_FILE') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
results = d.get('results', {})
for task, metrics in sorted(results.items()):
    acc = metrics.get('acc,none', metrics.get('acc_norm,none', metrics.get('exact_match,strict-match', 'N/A')))
    print(f'  {task}: {acc}')
"
    else
        echo "  No results found"
    fi
done

echo "PIPELINE_COMPLETE" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt
echo "=== PIPELINE FINISHED at $(date -u) ==="
SCRIPT_EOF

chmod +x /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/auto_eval_pipeline.sh
echo "Script deployed."

nohup bash /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/auto_eval_pipeline.sh > /dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"
echo "MONITORING" > /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt
sleep 2
cat /root/runs/contrastive_entrain_calib/pipeline_status.txt
